en.text:
Collecting a <void/>Void Breach grants 'Dimensional Breach' until your next Weapon Kill.

Scoring a Weapon Kill while Dimensional Breach is active grants a #e${22.5 + #d} HP <void/>Void Overshield for 8 seconds (12 with <void/>Echo of Persistence) and begins a 5 second timer. 

Additional weapon kills extend the timer back to 5 seconds.

enhanced (
var d = 2.5
#e More Void Overshield is granted per kill.
)
